title: Source-only all-local-Q3 multiplication-word majorant
question: Does the source-only slice of all actual Q3 local potential words admit a volume-independent entire generating majorant with both orientations?
method: Set field variables to zero after taking each actual onsite, Q3-edge and spatial-bond potential difference.
Compute the exact absolute source coefficient norm at radius R for one onsite, one Q3 edge and one spatial bond.
Sum one onsite, three Q3-edge and six spatial-bond choices at an active site and bound every length-n connected source-only word by A(R)^n.
Run independent SymPy and Fraction lanes for the factorial EGF, check endpoint/source orientation symmetry, and compile Lean R221 for the exact rate fixtures.
finding: The source-only local rate is A(1/2)=4741/2240 for the registered fixture, with t*A=4741/6720. The length-n source-only multiplication-word sum is bounded by A^n and its factorial generating series by exp(t*A); endpoint reversal preserves the coefficient norm.
decision_reason: This extends the entire-source candidate from one actual local word to all declared source-only local multiplication-word types with a bounded-degree choice envelope. The field-dependent operator lift is deliberately not inferred.

adversarial_review.check: The field variables are set to zero, so q-dependent coefficients and operator domains are outside the closed scope.
Ten local choices are a bounded-degree envelope and not a complete support-growth theorem for operator histories.
Absolute coefficient symmetry is not an adjoint or two-sided real-time identity.
The exponential bound is only a source-only multiplication-word series.
R221 checks exact rational coefficient and rate fixtures only.
No thermodynamic dynamics, KMS, GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A result is claimed.

qft_interface.closed: A source-only coefficient-level entire generating envelope for all declared local Q3 multiplication-word types.
qft_interface.open: Field-dependent operator history, commutators, spatial first-passage decay, all-shape exhaustion, common alpha, KMS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: No heat_root_incidence or A1/R-192 TECT production owner is supplied by the source-only package.

boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing source-only local-word checkpoint. It does not prove Q3 real-time dynamics, a thermodynamic QFT, C6, Sector A, Pre-A, TECT production or a Clay result.
next_action: Lift the source-only bound to a field/energy-weighted common-core norm, or record the exact obstruction to that lift, before attempting the two-orientation first-passage and common-alpha estimates.
